description: This file defines the Java interface HookReadPlatformService, which declares methods for retrieving hook-related data in the Fineract infrastructure, such as all hooks, specific hooks by ID, hooks by event, and new hook details.

classes.name: HookReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading hook data within the Fineract infrastructure, providing methods to retrieve hooks and hook details.

methods.name: retrieveAllHooks
methods.description: Retrieves all hooks as a collection of HookData objects.

methods.name: retrieveHook
methods.description: Retrieves a specific hook by its ID, returning a HookData object.

methods.name: retrieveHooksByEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a list of hooks associated with a particular event, identified by entity name and action name.

methods.name: retrieveNewHookDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for creating a new hook based on a template name.
